governance.note: One mechanism enters vs pjm-97: cc_mustrun_per_plant (MECH_CC_MUSTRUN_PER_PLANT, CC_REGULAR only) — each plant's CEMS-committed tranche (thermal_tranches_PJM.csv committed_pct, the measured minimum stable load) is forced on as a min-gen floor in its measured committed window (top online_frac fraction of hours by system load; the artifact's measured CEMS synchronization fraction, newly emitted for gas rows by derive_thermal_tranches.py with every pre-existing column frozen, rule 21). The real PJM LDA/voltage RMR structure: paid out-of-market (bid-cost recovery), offer prices untouched, the existing committed tranche becomes a forced quantity (rule 19 — no stacked floor). Self-targeting by the measurement (rule 18): western CCs already running above committed see a non-binding bound (probe: AEP/Central_PA CC unchanged). The CT_PEAKER leg was probed under a declared h7-22 D-4 window and DROPPED (12.8% overnight off-window binding, rule-12 bug; buys ~none of the eastern CT under-run). No fitted scalar in the delta, so the rule-22 LOO-before-promotion clause (cross-validating TUNED changes) is vacuous for this flip, as it was for pjm-97's own promotion. D-3 zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside (pjm98_cc_mustrun-ablation; the new mechanism is on the MECH_ABLATION_FIELDS off-list, so the twin neutralizes it).
governance.residuals_note: Honest fit record vs pjm-97 (both live rubric-v2.2 re-scores, same scorer; the keeper itself currently scores NOT-YET with undocumented FAILs): C1 15/16 -> 13/16, free 11/12 -> 9/12 — the floor closes the eastern SPATIAL residual it was built for (2024 probe: Dominion CC -81% -> -30% vs CAMPD, SWMAAC CC -52% -> -35%, EMAAC CC over-run +31% -> +25%, west unchanged) but raises aggregate CC_REGULAR volume: 2024 +21.1 -> +23.3 TWh (already-failing cell, worse), 2023 flips out of band (+8.9 TWh), and displaces CT_PEAKER 2024 to -8.2 TWh (flips out of band). C3a 2024 -10.9 -> -11.6%, 2025 -16.9 -> -17.1% (both already FAIL); C3b price duration/shape IMPROVES all three years (NRMSE 0.228/0.226/0.258 -> 0.205/0.218/0.254); C3c unchanged (2025-only FAIL). C7: the 2023 CT_PEAKER cell — already failing in the keeper (off-peak cv_ratio 0.491 < 0.5) — worsens to 0.436, a displacement side-effect of committed CC crowding shoulder-hour CT dispatch; every other gated C7 cell passes. C8 PASSES with the new mechanism active: CC_REGULAR forced share is within budget on the official per-plant D-2 basis (a plant dispatching above its committed floor is not forced; the 2024 single-year probe's 57.7% tranche-level figure was the committed share itself, not the per-plant statistic), and the CT_PEAKER grounded-above-budget notes carry over ~unchanged from the keeper's own mechanisms (the new floor does not touch CT). Zero fitted scalars in the delta; rule-22 LOO is vacuous (cross-validates TUNED changes only). NOT promoted: keeper swap is the owner's decision per the G-20 SS5 over-forcing flag — the mechanism is structurally real (measured LDA/voltage commitment) and fixes the spatial miss; the aggregate CC over-run and the C7 CT worsening are its honest cost.
